title: Endless Tower - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Endless Tower in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: An endless-mode tower of boss remixes, including Chromatic versions of bosses you have already beaten. It is the main endgame progression loop.

sections.title: How to Reach Endless Tower
sections.content: Unlocked in Act 3. Clearing floors rewards END rewards and unlocks further tiers.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Chromatic and remixed versions of the main roster

sections.title: Collectibles & Notable Loot
sections.content: Endless Tower rewards, high-tier Chroma, Alternate outfits
